headline: Slovak 2025 tax-benefit model in Lean (OECD 56/56 lines exact, 18/18 Finančná správa bonus examples); the new 2025 child-bonus withdrawal is avoided by letting the lower earner claim and stacks with the § 11 withdrawal into 51-55 % marginal rates (above 100 % with eight children); the 1 Jan 2025 text let pooled couples escape it until a 15 March 2025 fix, and § 32a's employee premium is provably dead law.
